effect.name: GM Directional Echo
effect.desc: Weighted temporal-style directional image echoes with smooth attenuation.
effect.shader: void main(){vec2 u=acScreenNorm;vec2 texSize=max(inputImg.size,vec2(1.0));vec2 d=vec2(cos(angle),sin(angle))*distance/texSize;vec4 s=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,u);vec4 q=vec4(0.0);float w=1.0;float z=0.0;for(int i=0;i<10;i++){float t=float(i)/9.0;q+=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,clamp(u-d*t,0.0,1.0))*w;z+=w;w*=decay;}q/=max(z,0.0001);gl_FragColor=mix(s,q,clamp(mixAmount,0.0,1.0));}
